query:
SELECT articleId, @row := @row + 1 as row_num 
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT articleId FROM article_votes WHERE visitorId LIKE 'seed_%' ORDER BY articleId) t, 
(SELECT @row := 0) r 
HAVING row_num % 12 = 1
LIMIT 20;
